dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Faust Area (NTS 83O/SW) (GIS data, polygon features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 554, Surficial Geology of the Faust Area (NTS 83O/SW).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Faust Area (NTS 83O/SW) (GIS data, polygon features)
